Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f7a980b3b8f80fe367f679da376cf76e800f9480 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 12:52:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] can: usb_8dev: usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory
 leak

Fix similar memory leak as in commit 7352e1d5932a ("can: gs_usb:
gs_usb_receive_bulk_callback(): fix URB memory leak").

In usb_8dev_open() -> usb_8dev_start(), the URBs for USB-in transfers are
allocated, added to the priv->rx_submitted anchor and submitted. In the
complete callback usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback(), the URBs are processed and
resubmitted. In usb_8dev_close() -> unlink_all_urbs() the URBs are freed by
calling usb_kill_anchored_urbs(&priv->rx_submitted).

However, this does not take into account that the USB framework unanchors
the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an
in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not
released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs().

Fix the memory leak by anchoring the URB in the
usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback() to the priv->rx_submitted anchor.

Fixes: 0024d8ad1639 ("can: usb_8dev: Add support for USB2CAN interface from 8 devices")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260116-can_usb-fix-memory-leak-v2-5-4b8cb2915571@pengutronix.de
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/usb/usb_8dev.c b/drivers/net/can/usb/usb_8dev.c
index 7449328f7cd7..3125cf59d002 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/usb/usb_8dev.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/usb/usb_8dev.c
@@ -541,11 +541,17 @@ static void usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback(struct urb *urb)
 			  urb->transfer_buffer, RX_BUFFER_SIZE,
 			  usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback, priv);
 
+	usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted);
+
 	retval = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
+	if (!retval)
+		return;
+
+	usb_unanchor_urb(urb);
 
 	if (retval == -ENODEV)
 		netif_device_detach(netdev);
-	else if (retval)
+	else
 		netdev_err(netdev,
 			"failed resubmitting read bulk urb: %d\n", retval);
 }
-- 
2.34.1

### Modifications by File

**File:** `drivers/net/can/usb/usb_8dev.c`

- In the `usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback()` function:
  - Added `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted);` before resubmitting the URB.
  - If `usb_submit_urb()` succeeds, the function returns immediately (the URB remains anchored).
  - If submission fails, added `usb_unanchor_urb(urb);` to remove the anchor, then the error handling proceeds as before.

### Relationships

The change ensures that the URB is re-anchored to the `priv->rx_submitted` list inside the completion callback. Previously, after an URB completed, it was unanchored by the USB core before the callback ran, so freeing all URBs by calling `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()` in `usb_8dev_close()` would miss these completed URBs, causing a memory leak. By re-anchoring the URB before resubmission (and unanchoring only if resubmission fails), the URB remains properly tracked, and the leak is fixed. This mirrors the fix applied in the similar `gs_usb` driver.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
resubmit_urb:
	usb_fill_bulk_urb(urb, priv->udev,
			  usb_rcvbulkpipe(priv->udev, USB_8DEV_ENDP_DATA_RX),
			  urb->transfer_buffer, RX_BUFFER_SIZE,
			  usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback, priv);

	retval = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
```
Reason:
The USB core automatically unanchors the URB before calling the completion callback. After `usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback()` processes the data, it resubmits the URB without re-anchoring it to `priv->rx_submitted`. Consequently, completed URBs are no longer in the anchor list, so `usb_kill_anchored_urbs()` (called on close) does not free them, causing a memory leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
resubmit_urb:
	usb_fill_bulk_urb(urb, priv->udev,
			  usb_rcvbulkpipe(priv->udev, USB_8DEV_ENDP_DATA_RX),
			  urb->transfer_buffer, RX_BUFFER_SIZE,
			  usb_8dev_read_bulk_callback, priv);

+	usb_anchor_urb(urb, &priv->rx_submitted);

	retval = usb_submit_urb(urb, GFP_ATOMIC);
+	if (!retval)
+		return;
+
+	usb_unanchor_urb(urb);
```
Reason:
The fix anchors the URB to `priv->rx_submitted` just before resubmission. If `usb_submit_urb()` succeeds, the URB remains anchored and will be properly freed on close. If submission fails, the URB is unanchored to avoid leaving an orphaned reference. This ensures that all completed and resubmitted URBs are tracked in the anchor list, eliminating the memory leak.
